stations.title: Imran
stations.say: Can members see the water report?
stations.note: He reads it out at meetings.

stations.title: water-report.js
stations.text: Makes a month's report, but only by hand.

stations.title: Member's phone
stations.text: Shows the June report, totals and all.

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran wants members to see the water report of any month on their phones.
Today he runs his report script by hand and reads the totals out at the meeting.
You make the server run the report as another program, safely, in four tasks.
Now asking for June runs the report, and its answer reaches the phone.
Same report, no meeting needed. Text typed in the address never becomes a command.
